status: frozen prospectively before opening current calibration outcome
scope: Judge sensitivity controls; no perceptual realism or additional statistical confirmation claim
inputs: Retained exact native and candidate PSBL from admitted calibration; original JPEG source/labels and identical judge hashes

arms.streak: Exact retained PSBL reconstruction; require pixel parity to calibration receipt
arms.disk: Retained streak positions/radius/colour/phase, exposure index set to zero; retain pooled RGB PSNR nondecrease guard, otherwise off; serialize actual PSBL bytes
arms.wrong_position: Diagnostic only: retained streak positions shifted horizontally by64 pixels modulo image width, with same per-frame appearances; no coding/PSNR admission claim
arms.brightness: Diagnostic only: retained streak positions/radius/exposure/phase with RGB colour(255,255,255); no coding/PSNR admission claim

report: Full-image WASB and BallTrack raw per-frame outputs and label-only scores; all existing frame labels/unknown policy, full and fixed64px crop LPIPS/DISTS/PSNR; native/wire/payload bytes for coding arms; actual changed-frame counts and diagnostic status
selection: All188 fullclip frames; a nested16-frame smoke for correctness/cost only, not extra sample
stop: Input/parity/judge/device mismatch or cost overflow stops; inactive controls are reported uninformative, never a judge validation pass; no tuning after result
